source_state: Uncommitted candidate; actual native executable and all Rust source hashes retained. Native and final source snapshots match. No hosted CI or commit claimed.
ownership_policy: After reservation and before acceptance, normalize payload Bytes through Vec and boxed slices; shared/custom/static backings copy visible bytes, excess capacity and hidden prefixes shrink, exact-size unique allocations can reuse memory. Header strings and header Vec capacity also shrink.
reservation: One guard owns bytes until transfer to the pending record. Cancellation while waiting on a full nonsticky channel now releases its reservation. Queue/in-flight/retry own accepted bytes until success or terminal release.

independent.broker: Apache Kafka4.3.1, fresh RF1 plaintext single-partition topics

independent.c: Actual librdkafka2.15.0 public consumer, pinned source/library, destroyed context and joined threads
independent.backing: 2MiB custom-owned allocations and 1MiB header string capacities; original payload owners drop after acceptance before acknowledgement
independent.fields: All offsets, timestamps, nullable/empty keys/values, UTF8, headers and boundary-sized high/low entropy values match Java/C expectations; HW9 each topic
independent.closure: All22 commands and broker parent-waited; both listener ports closed/reusable; raw stored codec IDs, CRC and counts checked
